guide.priorLine: This is the official FC Barcelona club account, posting almost exclusively training-ground content, matchday coverage, player interviews, and club milestones — treat nearly everything as on-beat by default.

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Training-session photos/videos of first-team and academy players during preseason camp in England.
examplesEnglish: The work continues. Another session awaits this afternoon. 👊

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Behind-the-scenes recap videos of full training days, often promoting Barça Play for extended footage.
examplesEnglish: A Sunday with a double training session 💪 The full video is now available on Barça Play 🎥 👉
🏴 England, Day 6. ▶️ See what happened at today's training camp on Barça Play

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Post-match mixed-zone interview clips with players or coach Flick reacting to preseason friendlies.
examplesEnglish: 🎤 Álvaro Cortés shares his thoughts on the preseason training camp.
🎙️ Flick gives his thoughts on the first preseason game

onBeatPatterns.pattern: New/debuting player welcome or first-impression posts (first session, first words, first goal).
examplesEnglish: 🎙️ Hear Bisiwu's first words as a blaugrana.
First day. First session. Welcome to Barça, Bisiwu! 💪

onBeatPatterns.pattern: Matchday result graphics, highlight reels, and player action shots from preseason friendlies.
examplesEnglish: 📺 Relive the best moments from today's game! @Midea
